name: Remix DNA TECH
description:
# DNA TECH Website Redesign & Content Update (EDIT EXISTING WEBSITE ONLY)

## IMPORTANT

This is NOT a request to build a new website.

This is an existing DNA TECH website that already has a modern design, layout, components, navigation, responsiveness, animations, and overall visual identity.

Your task is to IMPROVE and REFINE the current website while preserving its existing design language.

DO NOT redesign everything.

DO NOT replace the layout with another template.

DO NOT change the brand identity.

Instead, enhance what already exists.

The final website should feel like Version 2.0 of the current website—not an entirely different website.

---

# PROJECT GOAL

Transform the current website into a premium Data Intelligence website that communicates professionalism, trust, and innovation while keeping the UI clean, modern, and minimal.

The current design direction is already good.

Keep the visual style.

Improve the messaging.

Improve the UX.

Improve interactions.

Improve storytelling.

Improve content hierarchy.

---

# BRAND POSITIONING

DNA TECH is NOT simply a software company.

DNA TECH is a Data Intelligence company helping organizations make smarter decisions through:

• Market Research

• Data Collection

• Data Analytics

• AI-powered Insights

• Dashboard Development

• Software Solutions

Every page should reinforce one message:

"Helping organizations make smarter decisions through reliable data and intelligent technology."

The website should sell outcomes—not services.

---

# DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

KEEP the existing design language.

KEEP the existing layout structure.

KEEP the navigation style.

KEEP responsiveness.

KEEP the spacing philosophy.

KEEP rounded cards.

KEEP shadows.

KEEP buttons.

KEEP typography hierarchy.

KEEP the premium minimal look.

DO NOT convert the website into another style.

---

# COLOR SYSTEM

Use ONLY these primary colors.

Primary

#0B2442

White

#FFFFFF

Light Background

#F7F9FC

Borders

#E8EEF5

Secondary Text

#6B7280

Primary Text

#1F2937

Do NOT introduce new accent colors.

Do NOT use gradients.

Do NOT use neon colors.

---

# TYPOGRAPHY

Keep the existing typography if it already matches a modern sans-serif style.

If fonts need improvement, use:

Plus Jakarta Sans

Weights

400

500

600

700

Maintain generous spacing and readability.

---

# WEBSITE STRUCTURE

Keep these pages.

• Home

• About

• Services

• Solutions

• Contact

If an Insights page already exists, integrate its strongest content into the Home and Solutions pages instead of treating it as a primary navigation item, unless there is a clear business reason to keep it.

---

# CONTENT UPDATE

Rewrite all website copy.

DO NOT copy the company profile word-for-word.

DO NOT paste brochure paragraphs.

Use the company profile, brochure, and existing website only as reference material.

Rewrite everything specifically for the web.

Content should be:

• Short

• Clear

• Professional

• Human

• Modern

• Easy to scan

Avoid large paragraphs.

Every section should communicate value quickly.

Focus on benefits rather than technical descriptions.

---

# MESSAGING

Instead of listing services,

show how DNA TECH solves problems.

Instead of:

"We provide Market Research."

Write:

"Understand your market before making important decisions."

Instead of:

"Dashboard Development"

Write:

"Visualize your business performance in real time."

Sell confidence.

Sell insight.

Sell better decision making.

---

# HOMEPAGE

Keep the current structure but update content and improve visual storytelling.

Hero should communicate immediately:

Who DNA TECH is

What DNA TECH does

Why visitors should trust the company

What action they should take

Suggested headline:

Turning Data Into Better Decisions

Supporting text:

DNA TECH helps businesses, NGOs, startups, and public institutions make confident decisions through market research, ethical data collection, intelligent analytics, AI-powered solutions, and custom technology.

Buttons:

Get Started

Explore Services

---

# TRUST SECTION

Keep the section but modernize it.

Use clean badges or small cards.

Market Research

Data Collection

Business Intelligence

AI Solutions

Software Development

---

# ABOUT SECTION

Rewrite completely.

Keep it concise.

Explain WHY DNA TECH exists.

Explain how it helps organizations.

Use trust-building language.

---

# SERVICES

Rewrite every service.

Focus on outcomes.

Each service card should answer:

What problem does it solve?

How does DNA TECH help?

What is the benefit?

Keep cards visually consistent.

---

# SOLUTIONS PAGE

Organize by audience instead of technology.

Businesses

NGOs

Government

Startups

Education

For every audience explain:

Challenges

DNA TECH solution

Expected outcome

---

# CONTACT PAGE

Make it conversational.

Heading:

Let's Start a Conversation

Supporting text:

Every successful project begins with understanding your goals.

Tell us about your organization and we'll explore how research, analytics, or technology can support your next decision.

---

# PROCESS SECTION (IMPORTANT)

Completely redesign ONLY the interaction—not the overall visual style.

Create a premium scroll-driven interactive timeline.

When the user scrolls:

Step 1 becomes active

↓

Line animates downward

↓

Step 2 activates

↓

Step 3 activates

↓

Continue until the last step.

Timeline:

01

Discover

↓

02

Research Strategy

↓

03

Data Collection

↓

04

Analysis

↓

05

Insights & Reporting

↓

06

Implementation Support

Requirements:

• Vertical timeline on desktop

• Responsive horizontal/stacked version on mobile

• Animated progress line

• Active step highlight

• Icon animation

• Fade-up content

• Smooth transitions

• No external libraries required unless already in the project

• Use CSS transitions and lightweight JavaScript (or Intersection Observer) for scroll activation

The interaction should feel premium, similar to modern SaaS websites.

---

# ANIMATIONS

Keep animations elegant and subtle.

Include:

• Fade Up

• Fade Left

• Fade Right

• Card Hover Lift

• Button Hover

• Counter Animation

• Smooth Scroll

• Navbar Blur on Scroll

• Dashboard Floating Animation

• Timeline Scroll Animation

• Image Reveal

• Stagger Animation for cards

Avoid flashy effects.

No excessive motion.

---

# IMAGES

Do NOT use generic stock photos everywhere.

Prioritize:

Team collaboration

Research activities

Business meetings

Dashboard mockups

Field data collection

Analytics screens

Community engagement

Professional office scenes

Maintain consistent image style.

---

# PERFORMANCE

Keep the website lightweight.

Use:

HTML5

CSS3

Vanilla JavaScript

Optimize animations.

Lazy-load images where appropriate.

Maintain accessibility and responsive behavior.

---

# SEO

Update all page titles.

Update meta descriptions.

Use semantic HTML.

Maintain proper heading hierarchy.

Optimize for performance and accessibility.

---

# FINAL GOAL

The finished website should look like a premium technology company—not a digital brochure.

It should communicate trust within the first few seconds, clearly explain DNA TECH's value, guide visitors through a logical story, and encourage them to contact the company.

Preserve the existing design language and brand identity while significantly improving the messaging, user experience, content quality, and interactive elements.
